title: Project setup: Django project with one app per module and PostgreSQL
acceptance: Django 5 project runs locally; apps accounts/allocation/fees/complaints/reports/audit exist; custom User model with role; PostgreSQL via Docker Compose; base Bootstrap template

title: CI with GitHub Actions + PR template + CODEOWNERS
acceptance: Lint + migrations check + pytest on PostgreSQL run on every PR; PR must link an issue; repo owner auto-requested as reviewer

title: Seed demo data command (blocks/rooms/students/admin)
acceptance: python manage.py seed_demo creates 1 admin + 1 warden + 10 students + 2 blocks + 10 rooms + 1 fee structure; synthetic data only

title: Register and log in with institute email/roll number and role
acceptance: AC-F-001: valid credentials create an authenticated session with the correct role; duplicate roll number/email rejected; TC-Auth-01

title: Store passwords as salted hashes
acceptance: DB inspection shows only PBKDF2/Argon2 hashes; no plaintext password recoverable; TC-Sec-03

title: Enforce role-based access control at view (and API) layer
acceptance: AC-F-005: Student opening an Admin/Warden URL gets HTTP 403 and the attempt is logged (and vice versa); TC-Auth-05; TC-Sec-04

title: Expire inactive session after 20 minutes
acceptance: AC-F-004: after 20 idle minutes protected pages redirect to login; TC-Auth-04

title: Student updates own profile (phone/address/emergency contact)
acceptance: AC-F-002: updated fields persist and show on next login; student can edit only their own profile; TC-Auth-02

title: Admin manages hostel blocks/floors/rooms and capacity
acceptance: AC-F-014: CRUD on Block and Room (type single/shared + capacity); availability counts update immediately; TC-Alloc-05

title: Admin creates/views/updates/deactivates student records
acceptance: AC-F-011: CRUD reflects immediately in the student list; deactivate instead of delete; TC-Alloc-02

title: Admin allocates or reallocates a room (availability + gender policy)
acceptance: AC-F-012: allocation succeeds only for active rooms with free capacity and matching gender policy; occupancy updates atomically (select_for_update); TC-Alloc-03

title: Prevent allocation beyond room capacity
acceptance: AC-F-015: allocation on a full room is blocked with a clear error and logged; DB CHECK 0<=occupancy<=capacity; boundary tests N-1/N/N+1; TC-Alloc-06

title: Student views own room and roommates
acceptance: AC-F-010: dashboard shows block/room number/roommates for the logged-in student only; TC-Alloc-01

title: Admin configures fee structure per term and room type
acceptance: AC-F-022: new fee structure applies to later statements without changing already-paid records; amount must be > 0; unique per term+room type; TC-Fee-03

title: Student views itemised fee statement
acceptance: AC-F-020: totals = configured fee structure minus payments; shows dues/paid/due date; TC-Fee-01

title: Student and Admin dashboards wired to live data
acceptance: Student dashboard shows room + fee status + open complaints; admin dashboard shows occupancy summary and links to each console; works at 360px width

title: No card data stored - schema review
acceptance: Code/DB review confirms no card/CVV/PAN fields in any model; TC-Sec-06

title: Immutable audit log for admin actions
acceptance: write_audit(actor/action/target/outcome) inserts one AuditLog row inside the caller's transaction; no edit/delete in admin; used by allocation; TC-Sec-05

title: Student raises maintenance complaint with optional photo
acceptance: AC-F-030: complaint created with unique ticket ID and Open status; photo checked for type/size; TC-Maint-01

title: Sprint 1 demo video (1 min) uploaded to repo
acceptance: 1-minute screen recording of the working Sprint 1 build committed under docs/videos/ (or linked from README)

title: Password reset via OTP to registered email
acceptance: AC-F-003: 6-digit OTP stored hashed; expires in 10 minutes; single use; same reply whether or not email exists; TC-Auth-03

title: Responsive and accessible UI (360px / WCAG 2.1 AA)
acceptance: All pages usable at 360/768/1366px; labels on all fields; keyboard navigation; contrast check; TC-UX-01

title: HTTPS-only security settings (TLS 1.2+/HSTS/secure cookies)
acceptance: SECURE_SSL_REDIRECT/HSTS/secure cookie flags on in production settings; manage.py check --deploy passes; TC-Sec-02

title: Health check and restart policy
acceptance: /healthz returns 200; docker compose restart: unless-stopped; documented uptime approach

title: Student room change request and Admin approve/reject
acceptance: AC-F-013: Pending->Approved/Rejected logged with timestamp; approval calls allocate_room; TC-Alloc-04

title: Scale test with 5000 students / 2000 rooms
acceptance: Seeded large dataset; key pages stay within performance target; TC-Scale-01
